Relief shown pictorially. Pen-and-ink, pencil, and watercolor. Shows the landing of British troops below Bayoue Catalan and the position of American forces along the Mississippi River. Oriented with north to the upper-left. Watermark: J. Whatman 1811. Includes reference diagram of American and British forces, description of lands, and profiles of American defence works.
